notes.title: Improved Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue
notes.content:
[h3][b]The Prologue of Project Wunderwaffe has been improved. Various progressions have been added to make Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue even more enjoyable!
[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]This update includes all of the modifications made to the whole game in version 1.3.[/b]
[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1477700

[h3][b]Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue is only playable in survival mode and features a single difficulty setting: hard. Tier I can be completed in its entirety. 

NOTE: It is impossible to save the game because Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue is an excerpt of the full version.[/b][/h3]

[h3]Option to save, Tiers II and III, three difficulty levels (easy, medium, and hard), and all game stuff, are only available in Project Wunderwaffe's complete edition.
[/h3]

[h3][b]If you wish, you may reach out to us on Discord![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Building tunnels and elevators have been improved
notes.content:
[h1]Thank you for playing Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue and sharing your experiences.[/h1]
[h2]We have prepared an update that improves various aspects of the game.[/h2]

The Prologue is one step before the release of the full version is getting closer.
[b]The full version will offer a save function as well as Tier II and III access.[/b]

[b][h2]Discover what awaits you:[/h2] [/b]

✅ Building tunnels and elevators have been improved.
 
✅ Tunnels and elevators can be built on resources.
 
✅ Tunnels and elevators can be built through the buildings.

✅ Tunnels and elevators now require resources to build.
 
✅ UI has been improved.
 
✅ The number of resources drawn on the map at the start of the game has been balanced.
 
✅ Leaderboards have been reset.
 
✅ Five additional days have been added to the "time remaining".

notes.title: GAME RELEASED! 🚀 PLAY NOW! 🔥
notes.content:
[h1][b] FINALLY! [/b]🚀 [/h1]

[h1][b]Project Wunderwaffe: Prologue is NOW available to play for FREE![/b][/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1988830/Project_Wunderwaffe_Prologue/

[h3][b]Your task in the game is to keep enemy troops as far away from your base as possible. Be on the top of the LEADERBOARD! Fight and survive.[/b] 🔥[/h3]

[previewyoutube=dzIBx8Mo4OU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Leave your feedback and report bugs in this topics: [/b][/h3]
